includes: Course Coaches help teams build their greens using obstacles, ramps, tunnels & other course elements
gap: Exact duration of custom events not stated
blurb: Guests design and build their own mini golf hole during the first hour, then play a 9-hole course including their hole and others designed by teams in their round. Each green accommodates 2–6 players, with 18 total greens available. The experience lasts about two hours and includes a fully stocked bar for celebrations.
extraNote: Reservations require a valid credit card; cancellations or reductions without penalty up to 24 hours prior to TeeTime · Cancellations or reductions less than 24 hours prior to TeeTime charged full per person cost for unused spots · No outside beverages or food during public events; food allowed only for private parties · All Bars & Recreation facilities are cashless; accept major credit cards and mobile pay options · 1905 E North Ave, underneath Beans & Barley on Milwaukee’s East Side
